repo_prior_art.cite: none; no other active core concerns fixed-bin Hawkes recovery

published_prior_art.cite: Koyama2025 gives a small-bin coarse-grained spectral approximation; BacryMuzy2016 and EtesamiZhangSinghalKiyavash2016 require richer continuous second-order input.
BacryMuzy2016's second-order characterization supplies the general covariance background; the fixed-bin empty-stratum statement is a useful boundary corollary.
AchabBacryGaiffasMastromatteoMuzy2017 uses integrated higher cumulants; no located result gives this three-bin-covariance recovery formula.
CheyssonLang2022 gives binned-count Whittle asymptotics; the random-image restricted-logarithm delta method is a new but attached inference extension.
WangXieCuozzoMakXie2020 gives exact-event-time MLE confidence sets, not covariance-inverse coverage from binned counts.
No located fixed-bin Hawkes result characterizes the one-positive-lag compatibility fiber; ZhouPapadogeorgou2025 concerns the richer aggregated-count law.
Existing Hawkes uncertainty work is fixed-model or exact-event-time; no located result gives the stated honest rank/empty-graph adaptation frontier.

soundness_flags.label: ass:acyclic-support
soundness_flags.one_line: Acyclicity is a contribution-defining restriction for continuous-time Hawkes networks, not a standard Hawkes condition under the cited name; retag it novel and give its scientific applicability justification.

soundness_flags.label: ass:nonempty-support
soundness_flags.one_line: A≠0 is an identification-specific exclusion of the empty stratum, not a standard Hawkes regularity condition; retag it novel and justify it by the separately characterized nonidentification of β at A=0.

soundness_flags.label: ass:no-self-excitation
soundness_flags.one_line: Acyclicity of G(A) already excludes directed self-loops, so Aii=0 adds no independent member property and should be removed or the acyclicity convention narrowed explicitly.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 1–2
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The finite-lag inverse is conditional on the deliberately narrow known-bin, labeled, stationary, nonnegative, acyclic common-exponential-decay Hawkes class.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Exact recovery only within the stated acyclic common-decay model class; it makes no claim for cycles, heterogeneous decays, hidden labels, or unknown bin width.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 3–4
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The Gaussian and graph-coverage claims are conditional on fixed rank, decay, intensity, variance, and edge-separation margins.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Uniform asymptotic inference only over Mmargin(κ), with changing-rank, weak-edge, and empty-network honesty reserved for Open-ended Question 2.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines a discrete-time structural Hawkes process; its DAG restriction is for instantaneous causal relations, and its displayed zero-self condition is only φv,v(0)=0.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 165, §4, Definition 2; pp. 166–167, Assumption 2 and Corollary 4/Proposition 6
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The exponential class permits arbitrary coefficient matrices subject to the stationarity spectral-radius condition; it does not impose A≠0, and its recovery route uses covariance-spectrum zeros and covariance transforms.
For a stationary Hawkes process with an exponential-moment reproduction kernel, the bin-count sequence is exponentially strongly mixing; the paper then develops binned-count Whittle estimation.
The paper gives a nonasymptotic confidence set for continuous-time multivariate-Hawkes MLEs using score martingales, rather than a fixed-bin covariance inverse.
